fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: Professional whitening uses a controlled peroxide gel to lift stain from within the enamel. It works on natural teeth, and it works better when someone has checked yours first.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Your teeth have yellowed gradually with age - the type that responds most predictably

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Coffee, tea, red wine or smoking have dulled them

fields.label: List item
fields.value: You have an event coming up and want a modest, safe improvement

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Your teeth are healthy, with no untreated decay or gum disease

fields.label: List item
fields.value: You understand that crowns, veneers and fillings will not change colour

fields.label: List item

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We check for decay, gum health, exposed roots, cracks and existing restorations, and identify what’s actually causing the discolouration. Some causes respond well; some barely at all.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Surface stain comes off with a scale and clean. Sometimes that alone is enough, and we’ll tell you if it is rather than sell you whitening.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Lips and gums are carefully isolated and protected, the gel applied and activated by light, usually across a few cycles. Around an hour in the chair.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Impressions or a scan, then thin trays made to fit your teeth exactly, with gel to wear for a set time daily over one to two weeks. Slower, gentler on sensitivity, and easy to top up later.

fields.value: Avoid staining food and drink for 48 hours - coffee, tea, red wine, curry, beetroot, berries and tomato sauce.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: No smoking during that window if you possibly can.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Sensitivity to cold for a day or two is very common and settles; sensitive toothpaste helps.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Use a straw for dark drinks in the first few days.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Results fade gradually over months to years depending on your habits.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Keep your trays - a short top-up is far cheaper than starting again.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Where discolouration is mostly surface stain, cleaning may achieve most of what you want at a fraction of the cost.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: For intrinsic discolouration that won’t whiten, tetracycline staining, fluorosis, a dark root-treated tooth, covering the surface is the reliable answer.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Teeth naturally darken with age and there is nothing wrong with that. If your expectations wouldn’t be met, we’d rather say so than take your money.

fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: No treatment is risk-free, and you should hear this before you decide rather than afterwards.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Crowns, veneers, bridges and composite fillings do not whiten. If you have them on front teeth, whitening the surrounding natural teeth can make them stand out, and they may need replacing to match - a significant added cost you should factor in beforehand.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Temporary sensitivity to cold is the most common side effect, particularly with in-chair whitening.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Gum irritation can occur if gel contacts soft tissue, which is why professional isolation matters.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Results vary substantially between individuals, and the final shade cannot be guaranteed.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Grey-toned discolouration, tetracycline staining and single dark root-treated teeth respond poorly or unpredictably.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Whitening is not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or for children with developing teeth.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Whitening is not permanent. Expect gradual relapse, faster if you smoke or drink a lot of coffee, tea or red wine.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Over-the-counter and beauty-salon whitening is not supervised, may use ill-fitting trays and can cause burns or uneven results.
